name: immich-album-jobs
description: Companion app for Immich: rerunnable batch jobs that sync assets into albums

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
